## Services Directory

### 1. Apple MacBook Diagnostics & Logic Board Micro-Soldering
- **Supported Models:** MacBook Air (M1, M2, M3, Intel), MacBook Pro (13", 14", 15", 16" - M1/M2/M3 Pro/Max, Intel), Mac Mini, iMac.
- **Common Faults Resolved:** Liquid damage corrosion cleaning, no power / dead board, charging IC (CD3215/CD3217) failure, flexgate display cable repair, battery replacement with cycle reset, thermal throttling cleaning.

### 2. Windows Laptop & Desktop Motherboard Repair
- **Supported Brands:** Lenovo (ThinkPad, IdeaPad, Legion), HP (Pavilion, Envy, Omen, ProBook), Dell (XPS, Inspiron, Latitude, Alienware), Asus (ROG, TUF, ZenBook), Acer (Nitro, Predator, Swift).
- **Common Faults Resolved:** Broken body hinges reconstruction, motherboard short-circuit trace repair, blue screen (BSOD) hardware crashes, cracked IPS / OLED screen swaps, water damage restoration.

### 3. Laser & Inkjet Printer Servicing
- **Supported Brands:** HP LaserJet, Canon imageCLASS, Epson EcoTank, Brother DCP/HL series.
- **Common Faults Resolved:** Paper jam mechanism overhaul, pickup roller replacement, logic board formatter repair, duplex assembly servicing, streak/faded print resolution, red light blinking sponge reset.

### 4. Data Recovery & Storage Extraction
- **Supported Media:** External Hard Drives (Seagate, WD, Toshiba), SATA/NVMe SSDs, Camera SD cards, Encrypted partitions.
- **Protocols:** Logical data recovery for deleted/formatted disks, firmware reconstruction for undetected SSDs, head swap and platter extraction guidance.

### 5. VHS Video Tape Digitization
- **Supported Formats:** VHS, Compact VHS (VHS-C), 8mm/Hi8/Digital8, MiniDV.
- **Output Delivery:** High-bitrate H.264 MP4 digital video delivered on USB drive, hard disk, or secure cloud storage with sound balancing and noise reduction.
